chatHistory.renameHelp: Change the title without changing messages or running the Agent.
chatHistory.title: Conversation title
chatHistory.deleteConversationHelp: Remove this conversation from chat history. This cannot be undone. Strategies, completed actions and audit logs are not deleted.
chatHistory.deleteMessageHelp: Delete only this message from the conversation. Existing replies remain. This does not undo any action already executed by the Agent.
chatHistory.editHelp: Updates the message text only. Existing replies are not regenerated and the Agent will not run again.
chatHistory.discardHelp: Your unsaved message edits will be lost. The original message will remain unchanged.
chatHistory.busy: This conversation is running or has a pending continuation. Finish or stop the task before changing its history.
chatHistory.conflict: This message changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved; refresh the conversation before saving again.
chatHistory.missing: This message or conversation no longer exists. Refresh to see the current history.
chatHistory.notSynced: This message has not been confirmed by the server. Refresh or retry the original request before changing it.
chatHistory.tooLong: Messages may contain up to 16,000 characters. Nothing has been truncated or saved.
chatHistory.failed: The change was not confirmed by the server. Your content is unchanged; retry when the connection is available.
